user.title: Add a surf spot
user.description: The forecast comes from Open-Meteo, which is free and needs no key.

data_description.location: Put the marker on the sand or just off it.
data_description.beach_facing: The compass bearing you look along when you stand on the sand facing the sea: 270 for a beach that faces west. It decides which wind is offshore.

rules.title: What makes it good
rules.description: One problem makes the rating bad and two make it terrible. With no problems it is good, or great when everything is ideal. All of this can be changed later.

data_description.wave_min: Smaller waves show as flat, whatever the wind and tide.
data_description.wave_terrible: Bigger waves make the rating terrible.
data_description.period_ideal: With a shorter period the waves come closer together, which is good at best.
data_description.period_min: A shorter period is a problem.
data_description.offshore_gust_max: Offshore wind stays good up to here.
data_description.gust_terrible: Gusts this strong make the rating terrible.
data_description.calm_wind: Average wind lighter than this is ideal from any direction.
data_description.low_tide_hours: Hours either side of low water that count as low tide, which is a problem. Set to 0 to ignore the tide.
data_description.min_window_hours: Shorter stretches are not reported as a window.
data_description.tide_offset: Minutes added to Open-Meteo's tide times. Compare the next high tide sensor with a local tide table to check it.

error.cannot_connect: Open-Meteo could not be reached. Try again in a moment.
error.no_waves: Open-Meteo has no wave forecast for this place. Move the marker closer to the sea.

abort.already_configured: A spot with this name already exists.
